name: Industrial Barn Pendant Light
description: A classic barn-style pendant in a bold matte black finish. The wide dome shade (20cm diameter, 30cm drop) delivers broad downward illumination, making it ideal for kitchen islands, workshops, or café counters. Interior of the shade reflects warm light efficiently. Suspended on a black metal rod with a flush ceiling canopy for a clean industrial look.

name: Bell-Shaped Pendant Light
description: An elegant bell-shaped pendant with a deep, tulip-like curve and a satin matte black exterior. The compact 22cm x 20cm silhouette suits intimate dining areas or hallway accent points. The smooth, uninterrupted surface and gold-toned interior lining create a warm, focused glow that adds drama without bulk.
materialAndFinish: Metal, matte black with gold interior

name: Conical Pendant Light
description: A sleek, tapered cone pendant (24cm x 30cm) in a striking matte black finish. The slender silhouette and angular form make it a natural fit for minimalist or Scandinavian interiors. Suspended on a black wire from a ceiling canopy, it delivers a direct downward beam perfect for dining tables or task areas.

name: Saucer Flare Pendant Light
description: A distinctive flared-saucer pendant (15cm x 21cm) with a matte black top and a warm gold-painted interior. The wide flared lip casts a dramatic halo of reflected light beneath, creating a moody, café-inspired ambience. Compact form suits low ceilings and intimate spaces.
materialAndFinish: Metal, matte black with gold interior

name: Dome Bell Pendant Light
description: A smooth, dome-bell pendant (20cm x 17cm) in a deep matte black exterior with a contrasting copper-gold interior. Its compact upright form suits clustered multi-pendant arrangements or as a standalone accent over a bedside or console. The interior finish warms the emitted light beautifully.
materialAndFinish: Metal, matte black with copper-gold interior

name: Ribbed Dome Pendant Light
description: A sculptural ribbed dome pendant (16cm x 27cm) in a deep green-black matte finish. Horizontal ribbing across the surface adds tactile depth and visual interest, making this piece equally at home in artisan cafés and luxury residential dining rooms. The elongated drop wire creates a bold vertical statement.
materialAndFinish: Metal, deep green-black matte with ribbed texture

name: Ribbed Disc Pendant Light
description: A low-profile dome pendant (12cm x 23cm) with a matte black finish and subtle ribbed texture along the rim. Its broad, flat silhouette evokes vintage factory lighting, well-suited for over-counter or island installations. Suspended on a slim black wire for an understated look.
materialAndFinish: Metal, matte black with ribbed rim

name: Dome Bowl Pendant Light
description: A generous bowl-dome pendant (20cm x 18cm) in matte black with a warm copper-gold interior lining. The classic hemispherical shape provides wide ambient light distribution, ideal for kitchen islands or dining tables. Sleek wire suspension maintains a modern, clutter-free look.
materialAndFinish: Metal, matte black with copper-gold interior

name: Layered Ribbed Pendant Light
description: A striking tiered-ribbed pendant (13cm x 25cm) in matte black with multiple concentric horizontal bands that catch and diffuse light. The layered effect gives it a graphic, architectural presence. Excellent as an accent pendant in entryways or above a reading nook.
materialAndFinish: Metal, matte black with layered ribbing

name: 3-Light Cluster Pendant Set
description: A dramatic 3-pendant cluster set suspended from a single 38cm plate (individual shades 15cm x 16cm). Each shade is a compact dome in matte black, hanging at staggered heights for a dynamic, layered look. Ideal for dining rooms with double-height ceilings or open-plan living areas. The wide ceiling plate accommodates all three drop cables.

name: 2-Light Conical Cluster Pendant
description: A twin conical pendant cluster mounted on a 30cm ceiling plate (individual shades 18cm x 9cm). Two slender cone shades hang at varying lengths, creating a sculptural, modern composition. The matte black cones contrast beautifully against white or concrete ceilings.

name: Bare Bulb Pendant Holder
description: A minimalist bare-bulb pendant holder (8cm x 6cm) with a matte black ceiling rose and braided wire, designed to let the bulb take centre stage. Ideal for Edison or globe-style filament bulbs that serve as décor in their own right. Simple, versatile, and infinitely stackable.

name: Brass Chain Pendant Holder
description: An ornate brass chain pendant holder (6cm x 5cm) with a decorative canopy and classic link chain suspension. The antique brass finish adds heritage charm and pairs beautifully with vintage-style bulbs. Use as a single accent or in multiples for a dramatic installation.

name: Black Pendant Holder with Decorative Base
description: A compact pendant holder (6cm x 5cm) with a matte black ceiling rose and a sculptural, florette-style base socket cap. The detailed base adds a decorative element even without a shade, suitable for bare-bulb or small-shade configurations in eclectic interiors.

name: Conical Pendant with Brass Socket
description: A slender conical pendant shade (25cm x 19cm) in matte black with a prominent antique brass E27 socket ring, creating a two-tone industrial-vintage statement. The brass accent at the collar adds warmth and craftsmanship to an otherwise minimal silhouette.
materialAndFinish: Metal, matte black with brass socket ring

name: Factory Dome Pendant Light
description: A wide factory-style dome pendant (20cm x 23cm) in a rich matte black with a vintage brass E27 socket, evoking the aesthetic of early 20th-century industrial workshops. The broad dome distributes light generously across work surfaces or dining areas.
materialAndFinish: Metal, matte black with brass socket

name: Large Dome Pendant Light
description: A substantial hemispherical dome pendant (24cm x 24cm) in matte black with a warm copper-gold interior. The generous bowl shape provides wide, ambient illumination suited to open-plan dining and kitchen spaces. The interior gold lining bathes the space in a warm, inviting glow.
materialAndFinish: Metal, matte black with copper-gold interior

name: Shallow Conical Pendant with Brass Accent
description: A wide, shallow-angled conical shade (18cm x 27cm) in black with a prominent antique brass ring at the base, giving it a dual-material character. The low-profile cone casts light in a broad pool below, making it perfect above dining tables or kitchen counters.
materialAndFinish: Metal, black with antique brass accent

name: Large Dome Bell Pendant Light
description: A proportioned dome-bell pendant (24cm x 21cm) in deep matte black with a smooth, clean exterior. Larger than many of its counterparts, it delivers substantial ambient and task lighting. The wide opening and classic dome silhouette suit restaurants, hotels, and residential open kitchens alike.

name: Wide Dome Pendant with Orange Interior
description: A dramatic wide-dome pendant (16.5cm x 16cm) in matte black with a vivid burnt-orange interior lining. The contrasting interior creates a warm, saturated downlight effect that energises the space below. A bold choice for accent lighting in bars, restaurants, or creative studios.
materialAndFinish: Metal, matte black with orange interior

name: Flat Dome Pendant Light
description: A generous flat-bottomed dome pendant (15cm x 27cm) in satin matte black. The extra-wide, shallow profile maximises light spread across large surfaces—ideal for billiard tables, long dining tables, or workshop benches. Clean minimal styling fits seamlessly into modern and industrial interiors.

name: 3-Light Vintage Socket Cluster
description: A trio of antique brass E27 sockets (20cm diameter plate) suspended from a single ornate ceiling medallion at varying heights. No shades—the bare vintage sockets and Edison bulbs become the centrepiece. Evokes Parisian brasserie charm and bohemian loft aesthetics.

name: White Conical Pendant Light
description: A crisp, tapered conical pendant (25cm x 19cm) in a clean gloss white finish—a refreshing departure from the darker tones in the range. The white exterior maximises perceived brightness and suits Scandinavian, coastal, or minimalist interiors. Suspended on a white cable from a white ceiling canopy.

name: Angled Cone Pendant with Brass Detail
description: A tall, elegantly angled cone pendant (30cm x 18cm) in matte black with a brass accent ring at the socket, giving it a refined industrial character. The elongated form and bold geometry make it a strong standalone feature in high-ceiling corridors or above kitchen islands.
materialAndFinish: Metal, matte black with brass accent

name: Large Bowl Pendant Light
description: A generously scaled bowl pendant (20cm x 47.5cm) in matte black—a bold, wide dome designed for high-volume spaces such as hotel lobbies, restaurant dining rooms, or loft apartments. The deep bowl contains and focuses light beneath while the black exterior recedes into the ceiling. A statement piece that commands attention.

name: Extra-Large Bowl Pendant Light
description: The widest in the bowl pendant family (26.5cm x 47.5cm), this statement dome commands any large open space. With its broad diameter and matte black finish, it provides excellent ambient coverage for hotel lobbies, farmhouse kitchens, or commercial dining areas. The clean silhouette suits both heritage and contemporary interiors.

name: Antique Brass Wide Dome with Globe
description: A unique composite pendant (35cm x 26cm) featuring a wide antique brass dome shade paired with a frosted globe glass diffuser beneath—combining directional shade light with soft 360° globe glow. The antiqued brass surface adds warmth and patina suited to colonial or heritage interiors.
materialAndFinish: Antique brass metal, frosted glass globe

name: Medium Dome Bowl Pendant
description: A well-proportioned medium dome bowl (15cm x 27cm) in matte black. A versatile pendant that works equally well as a single feature or in a row of three above a dining table. The deep bowl profile focuses downward illumination and minimises glare.

name: Narrow Bell Pendant Light
description: A tall, narrow bell pendant (21cm x 17cm) in a deep matte black finish. The elongated bell profile casts a tightly focused beam, making it ideal for accent or task lighting above counters, shelves, or artwork. Compact enough to use in multiples without visual clutter.

name: Wide Barn Pendant with Brass Accent
description: A broad barn-dome pendant (30cm x 25cm) in matte black with a vintage brass socket ring. The wide diameter ensures generous ambient light output, while the brass accent adds artisanal warmth. An ideal anchor pendant for open-plan dining or kitchen spaces.
materialAndFinish: Metal, matte black with brass socket ring

name: Oversized Flat Dome Pendant
description: The largest single pendant in the collection (60cm x 24cm), this oversized flat dome in matte black is designed for expansive spaces—hotel atriums, restaurant dining halls, or double-height living rooms. Its extraordinary diameter provides maximum light coverage and an unmistakably bold visual presence.

name: Tapered Dome Pendant Light
description: A gracefully tapered dome (32cm x 25cm) in a deep matte black finish with gently curved sides—broader than a cone, rounder than a barn. This transitional silhouette sits between rustic and contemporary, making it extremely versatile for residential and hospitality settings.

name: Wide Barn Pendant with Vintage Brass Socket
description: A wide, open barn shade (26cm x 17cm) in matte black paired with a prominent antique brass bulb socket ring. The low-profile, wide-brim form directs light broadly downward. The brass-ringed socket adds a heritage detail that elevates the piece beyond a standard industrial pendant.
materialAndFinish: Metal, matte black with antique brass socket

name: Flared Cone Pendant Light
description: A dramatically flared cone pendant (30cm x 15cm) in matte black, with a wide lip that curves outward at the base like a trumpet bell. This distinctive silhouette provides a wide light spread directly below while the slender profile remains visually light. Suits coastal, industrial-scandi, and café interiors.

name: Moroccan Pierced Globe Pendant – Copper
description: An exquisite handcrafted globe pendant (47cm x 30.5cm) in a rich antique copper finish. The surface is intricately pierced with fine geometric patterns, casting a breathtaking lattice of light and shadow across the room when lit. Suspended on a decorative chain from an ornate canopy. A showpiece for Moroccan-inspired, bohemian, or luxury eclectic interiors.

name: Moroccan Teardrop Pendant – Antique Brass
description: An elegant teardrop-shaped Moroccan pendant (33cm x 20cm) in antique brass with intricate pierced geometric motifs. The pointed teardrop silhouette and ornate cut-work create mesmerising star-and-lattice shadow patterns. Chain suspended from a classical canopy. Perfect for boutique hotels, spa lounges, or eclectic dining rooms.

name: Moroccan Pierced Sphere Pendant – Antique Brass
description: A compact spherical Moroccan lantern pendant (30cm x 15cm) in antique brass with finely pierced geometric cut-work. Smaller and more intimate than JH01, it suits bedside pendants, powder rooms, or clustered ceiling installations. The pierced pattern creates a starfield effect when lit.

name: Moroccan Pierced Dome Pendant
description: A dome-shaped Moroccan pendant (30cm x 25cm) in antique brass with dense, fine-punched geometric patterns across the entire surface. Unlike the spherical JH series, the flat dome top gives it a more grounded, lantern-like character. The dense perforation pattern produces a particularly rich shadow tapestry.
materialAndFinish: Handcrafted antique brass, punched metal dome

name: Moroccan Pierced Bell Pendant
description: A bell-shaped Moroccan pendant (25cm x 21cm) in antique brass, entirely covered in fine circular punch-work creating a delicate dotted light pattern. The bell shape provides a distinct Mughal-influenced silhouette. Suitable for intimate dining, master bedroom pendants, or clustered in boutique hotel rooms.
materialAndFinish: Handcrafted antique brass, punched metal bell

name: Moroccan Pierced Dome Pendant – Small
description: The most compact Moroccan dome pendant (20cm x 16.5cm), perfect for intimate spaces or use in pairs. Antique brass surface with fine circular punch-work across the dome. An accessible entry into the Moroccan pendant range, ideal for bedrooms, reading corners, or guest bathrooms.

name: Moroccan Pierced Dome Pendant – Black
description: The classic dome Moroccan pendant (20cm x 20cm) finished in a rare matte black, offering a more dramatic and contemporary take on the handcrafted pierced-metal tradition. The black finish creates high contrast star-like pinhole patterns, lending it a celestial quality. Ideal for moody, modern-eclectic spaces.
materialAndFinish: Handcrafted metal, matte black with pierced pattern

name: Moroccan Pierced Dome Pendant – Copper
description: The same elegant 20cm x 20cm dome silhouette as JH07, finished in a warm antique copper tone. The copper surface deepens with age, developing a rich patina that adds character. The pierced dot pattern glows with warmth when lit, ideal for earthy, bohemian, and artisanal interiors.

name: Moroccan Flat Dome Pendant – Copper
description: A wide, flat-bottomed dome pendant (15cm x 27cm) in polished hammered copper. The smooth hammered surface catches light with a liquid warmth, while the hemispherical bowl shape casts a wide, ambient pool below. A more refined, less ornate take on the Moroccan pendant, bridging artisan craft and contemporary design.

name: Moroccan Flat Dome Pendant – Antique Brass
description: Identical in form to JH08 (15cm x 27cm), this flat dome pendant is finished in antique brass with a fine circular punch-work pattern. The brass tone adds a classic, warm quality to the hammered surface. Suits heritage and transitional interiors equally.
materialAndFinish: Handcrafted antique brass, punched flat dome

name: Moroccan Wide Dome Pendant – Hammered Brass
description: A substantial wide dome pendant (30cm x 27cm) in hammered antique brass, combining the punched-metal craft of the Moroccan range with a broader, more generously scaled silhouette. The hammered texture adds depth and catches light dynamically. The larger size suits grand spaces, hotel lobbies, and high-ceiling interiors.
materialAndFinish: Hammered antique brass, punched wide dome

name: 12-Light Gold Chandelier – JC01
description: A majestic 12-light chandelier (30 inch x 24 inch) in a gleaming polished gold/brass finish. Two tiers of gracefully curved arms radiate from a central sculpted column. Each arm terminates in a candle-style socket, creating a formal, luminous crown suited to grand dining rooms, hotel lobbies, and ballrooms. Adjustable chain suspension.

name: 12-Light Gold Chandelier – JC02
description: A wide-spanning 12-light chandelier (36 inch x 24 inch) in polished brass-gold. A broad two-tier arrangement with elegantly curved arms and candle-style sockets, this chandelier commands attention in large dining rooms and hotel atriums. The wider span compared to JC01 provides greater light distribution across the space.

name: 12-Light Black Iron Chandelier – JC03
description: A striking 12-light black iron chandelier (36 inch x 24 inch) with two sweeping tiers of curved arms adorned with decorative leaf details. The bold matte black finish contrasts with the organic, flowing arm shapes to create a dramatic country-house aesthetic. Candle-style sockets with optional flame-tip bulbs.
materialAndFinish: Black iron, matte finish with leaf accents

name: 12-Light Antique Chandelier – JC04
description: A refined 12-light chandelier (30 inch x 23 inch) in an antique dark finish, blending bronze and charcoal tones for an aged, classical look. The two-tier arm arrangement features graceful curves and candle sockets. This piece strikes a balance between formal grandeur and understated elegance, suited to traditional libraries, manor dining rooms, and heritage boutique hotels.

name: 6-Light Black & Gold Chandelier – JC05
description: An elegant 6-light chandelier (27.5 inch x 22 inch) with a slender black central column and curved arms tipped in gold candle holders. The two-tone palette of black and gold delivers a sophisticated Art Deco-influenced presence. Single-tier arrangement with graceful, restrained curves—ideal for intimate dining rooms, master suites, and boutique hospitality venues.
materialAndFinish: Black metal with gold candle holders

name: 9-Light Black Chandelier – JC06
description: A dramatic 9-light chandelier (22 inch x 30 inch) in matte black, featuring a tall central column with two tiers of arms and candle-style sockets. The elongated vertical profile creates a dramatic drop effect, ideal for high-ceiling spaces. Gold-tipped candle cups add a subtle warmth to the otherwise monochrome composition.
materialAndFinish: Matte black metal with gold-tipped candle cups

name: 6-Light Modern Black Chandelier – JC07
description: A sculptural 6-light chandelier (25 inch x 37 inch) in matte black with sweeping, elongated arms that curve outward and upward in a fluid, organic arc. The unusually tall drop height (37 inch) makes this ideal for double-height spaces or dramatic stairwells. Gold candle holders punctuate the black arms with warmth.
materialAndFinish: Matte black metal with gold candle holders
